turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My grandson says I should do my shopping on the computer now. I've never done it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's easier than it sounds. You pick a supermarket's website, put things in a basket, and choose a time for them to bring it to your door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do I have to pay the driver?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No, you pay by card on the website when you order. The driver just hands over the bags.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if they bring me the wrong thing?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can say no at the door, and they'll take it back and refund you. They usually list any swaps on your receipt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: press the wrong button and order fifty tins of beans.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Before you pay, there's always a page that lists everything with the amounts. Read it slowly, and you can change anything there.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Maybe do the first order with your grandson sitting next to you. After that, it'll save you whole afternoons.
